proposal.summary: SimpleMachinesForum 2.1.1 and earlier allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary PHP code by modifying themes; vendor states administrators are intended to be able to modify themes and choose PHP code to execute.
proposal.cwe_quote: allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary code by inserting a vulnerable php code because the themes can be modified by an administrator.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the administrative theme-editing functionality and reproduce code execution in a controlled environment; if confirmed, coordinate disclosure and recommend restricting theme-editing to trusted administrators or applying server-side sanitization, and consider documenting vendor design decision in advisory.

evidence_quotes.quote: SimpleMachinesForum 2.1.1 and earlier allows remote authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary code by inserting a vulnerable php code because the themes can be modified by an administrator.
NOTE: the vendor's position is that administrators are intended to have the ability to modify themes, and can thus choose any PHP code that they wish to have executed on the server.
